evidence.reason: The admission marker is intended to be durable: acquire writes this run's token and fsyncs the file, then sets acquired. It never fsyncs the containing directory after O_CREAT|O_EXCL, so a crash can lose the directory entry even though the run believes admission is held; the analogous unlink in release also needs a directory fsync. This is an existing durability bug in the marker, not a new scope requirement.
